column1: # Stage S11 J2f — xtask's local database lane, its deploy-side backup, restore and drill, and the
# database source checks become the database_operations crate; the rest of the deploy group and the
# staging compose-path check become the deployment crate.
# Paths name the tree before the moves. The crate roots (`lib.rs`), the `super::` paths that climb
# out of a renamed module and the bin's `commands::deploy::` spellings are fixed by hand.
# the local database lane, the deploy-side database verbs and the database checks become
# the website and staging deploy drivers and the staging compose-path check become deployment
# the xtask consumers import the two crates
